description: Token rows m of the Kimi-K3.1 in_proj GEMM (N=6288, K=7168 a rank at TP8) in decode and DSpark verify steps: narrow steps of 1 to 8 rows and wide verify steps of R requests x 8 tokens, within the 16-, 128- and 384-row buckets of the layer launch. Every case reads the 90 MB weight. Derived from the serving configuration and the AgentX corpus workload guide; not yet confirmed by a live capture.

cases.source: decode of one request (narrow step, served by Kimi-K3's narrow launch in production); 16-row bucket, padded
narrow step with an odd row count; 16-row bucket, padded
DSpark verify of one request, R=1 x L=8 (narrow step, the interactive single-request width); 16-row bucket, padded
wide verify R=2 x L=8, the smallest wide bucket
wide verify R=12 x L=8, padded into the 128-row bucket
unaligned row count (not a multiple of 16) in the 128-row bucket
wide verify R=16 x L=8, the mid width
wide verify R=36 x L=8, padded into the 384-row bucket
unaligned row count ending inside the second 192-row tile of the 384-row bucket
wide verify R=48 x L=8, the largest compiled width
